name: Outrun
source:
A short adult Kinectic novel about loving your family.

Your life is turned upside down by a crazy succession of events, and now you have to protect those you cherish the most.

Can you soldier on through the pain to achieve your dreams?

[From [url=https://tataugas.itch.io/outrun]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于爱护家人的成人无分支短篇小说。

一连串疯狂的事件，彻底颠覆了你的生活。如今，你必须保护自己最珍爱的人。

你能忍痛前行，实现自己的梦想吗？

[摘自[url=https://tataugas.itch.io/outrun]Itch.io[/url]]
